title: Villager Stats Wand
description: Use an item instead of a command
body:
# Discontinuation Notice
I will no longer update this pack. Instead, the Wand item will be merged into the [main pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/villager-stats) in a future release.

# Add-on for my [Villager Stats](https://modrinth.com/datapack/villager-stats) data pack
Instead of opening your chat and running a command, simply
equip the new **Villager Stats Wand** and use it while looking
at a villager.

## Crafting
![The crafting recipe for the Villager Stats Wand (an Emerald placed above a Stick)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f82cbabbb76a6904540f29b7423dfe5b2129b2d7.png)

## Usage
### Cooldown
After using the wand, you'll have to wait for ¾ of a second
until you can use it again. You'll hear a sound if using
the Wand was successful.
### Querying information about a villager
While holding the wand item, interact with
the villager. Alternatively, simply use the
item (right click by default) while looking
at a villager. Depending on the Wand's mode,
you will see information about the villager
(equivalent to running `/trigger villager_stats`),
see a **highlight outline** around the villager's
**job site** or **home (bed)** (equivalent to running
`/trigger villager_block set 1` or `/trigger villager_block set 2`,
respectively).

### Changing the Wand's mode
While sneaking, use the wand while not
looking at an entity. Above your hotbar,
you'll see a message indicating the mode
change (`Mode Changed: <Old Mode> -> <New Mode>`):

![A message above the hotbar stating "Mode Changed: Highlight Job Site -> Highlight Home"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5decde44348658cc2f1ff16e301ed2beb33053a5.png)
